title: AI Model API Platforms: 7 Compared for Image and Video Jobs (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.tagline: Best overall for running several models from one API call
tools.modelSupport: 100+ image, video and audio models as nodes
tools.note: Pricing page checked 2026-11-02: API and MCP access are on every plan, and runs spend your credits.

quickstart.label: Add the Wireflow connector to Claude Code, from the wireflowINC/skills README. Then run /mcp to sign in.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: Or run a saved board from code: send its input values to this endpoint with an API key, then poll the execution. The request format is in the API reference linked under Docs.

tools.name: fal
tools.tagline: Best for reaching 1,000+ media models through one queue

quickstart.label: Install the fal CLI, from fal's Serverless docs. Then test an app with fal run and ship it with fal deploy.

tools.name: Replicate
tools.tagline: Best for open models and for deploying your own
tools.claudeConnection: Remote MCP server or replicate-mcp npm package
tools.modelSupport: Over 100 official models plus community models
tools.note: For predictions created through the API, output files are deleted after an hour (checked 2026-10-11).

quickstart.label: Setup reference: create a prediction, from the Replicate docs. This is a documentation URL, not an executed API example.

tools.name: Runware
tools.tagline: Best for sending many image tasks in one request
tools.modelSupport: Image, video, audio, LLM and 3D models
tools.note: The linked repository is the official Python SDK. A TypeScript SDK is documented as well.

quickstart.label: Send one image task, from the Runware Models API introduction. The request body is an array, so more task objects can go in the same call.
quickstart.code:
curl https://api.runware.ai/v1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNWARE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[
    {
      "taskType": "imageInference",
      "taskUUID": "a770f077-f413-47de-9dac-be0b26a35da6",
      "model": "xai:grok-imagine@image-quality",
      "positivePrompt": "A golden retriever on a park bench, cinematic lighting",
      "width": 1024,
      "height": 1024
    }
  ]'

tools.name: WaveSpeedAI
tools.tagline: Best for checking a price before a run
tools.modelSupport: 1000+ image, video, audio, 3D and LLM models
tools.note: The linked repository is the official MCP server. Its get_price tool quotes a price before a run.

quickstart.label: Add the WaveSpeedAI MCP server to Claude Code, from the WaveSpeedAI/mcp-server README. It runs with npx and your API key.

tools.name: Together AI
tools.tagline: Best for open models and FLUX images on a prepaid balance
tools.modelSupport: Open models and FLUX image models
tools.note: Fully prepaid, with a minimum $15 first credit purchase; the billing docs say there are no free trials (checked 2026-10-11).

quickstart.label: The image endpoint, from Together's images overview: one POST that names a model, such as FLUX.2 dev, and returns the image URL.

tools.name: DeepInfra
tools.tagline: Best for pay-per-use open models with no contract
tools.modelSupport: Text, image, video, speech and embedding models
tools.note: Webhooks are a feature of the native API and are not supported with the OpenAI-compatible API (checked 2026-10-11).
